      <div class="ab-label">About me</div>
      <p>I wanted to do science. I ended up in economics, which is close enough. I still get to form hypotheses, collect data, and find out whether the idea survives. The questions asked in economics happen to be about people and history, which I would have been interested in anyway.</p>
      <p>I use R and Stata for most of the work here. Python when necessary. I try to make the code available alongside the output. Most of what I publish is not finished. That is fine.</p>
      <p>I am still early and I do not always know what I am doing. I am fairly honest about that. But I think that is a better starting point than pretending otherwise.</p>
      <p class="ab-site-note">This site is an experiment in having one place for everything: outputs, notes, things I made, things I thought about. I am forcing myself to have a friendly interface for people interested in what I do, rather than sending them to a GitHub repos. I built it with Quarto. Claude did most of the heavy lifting, not going to lie, which you can probably tell if you look at the source code. Or the design, for that matter. But it works. I might redo it eventually in something simpler, Hugo maybe, or just plain HTML. But for now this is what exists.</p>

<!-- Timeline positioning script:
     Reads the actual rendered right-edge of .ab-tl-date relative
     to .ab-timeline and sets --tl-x so the line and dot land
     exactly at the end of the date column regardless of container
     offset, Quarto padding, or screen width. -->
<script>
(function () {
  function positionTimeline() {
    var timeline = document.querySelector('.ab-timeline');
    if (!timeline) return;
    var firstDate = timeline.querySelector('.ab-tl-date');
    if (!firstDate) return;
    var tlLeft  = timeline.getBoundingClientRect().left;
    var dateRight = firstDate.getBoundingClientRect().right;
    var x = Math.round(dateRight - tlLeft + 10); /* 10px gap into the whitespace */
    timeline.style.setProperty('--tl-x', x + 'px');
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', positionTimeline);
  } else {
    positionTimeline();
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', positionTimeline);
})();
</script>
